#!/usr/bin/env bash
# usage: measure-population.sh <syzygy-worktree>
# Extends the M1 measurement script (docs/evidence/pwb-m1-polaris-lane-a-measurement-2026-09-13.json) with the population block: same daemon invocation and capture shape, one added offline derivation step.
set -u
WT="$1"
S=$SESSION_SCRATCHPAD/m1-population
mkdir -p "$S"
STATE="$S/state"; rm -rf "$STATE"; mkdir -p "$STATE"
cd "$WT"
git status --short  # must be empty before launching
node apps/three-surface-poc/dist/main.js --repo /home/tze/GitHub/butlers --port 0 --state-dir "$STATE" > "$S/daemon.log" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
for i in $(seq 1 180); do
  if grep -q 'Syzygy Three-Surface POC: http' "$S/daemon.log" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
  if ! kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null; then echo "daemon died"; cat "$S/daemon.log"; exit 1; fi
  sleep 1
done
URL=$(grep -o 'http://[^ ]*/' "$S/daemon.log" | head -1)
grep -E 'Observed revision' "$S/daemon.log"
curl -s -o "$S/polaris-direct.html" -w "direct status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n" "${URL}polaris"
curl -s -o "$S/polaris-tailnet.html" -H 'Host: tzeusy.parrot-hen.ts.net' -w "tailnet status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n" "${URL}polaris"
TOKEN_FILE=$(find "$STATE" -name 'machine-credential.token' | head -1)
curl -s -o "$S/api-poc.json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat "$TOKEN_FILE")" -w "machine status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n" "${URL}api/poc"
kill $PID; wait $PID 2>/dev/null
echo "syzygy=$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD) butlers=$(git -C /home/tze/GitHub/butlers rev-parse HEAD)"
node -e "
const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs');
const { derivePopulationBlock } = require('$WT/packages/three-surface-poc-core/dist/evidence-population.js');
const apiPoc = JSON.parse(readFileSync('$S/api-poc.json', 'utf8'));
const direct = readFileSync('$S/polaris-direct.html', 'utf8');
const tailnet = readFileSync('$S/polaris-tailnet.html', 'utf8');
const butlersRevision = require('node:child_process').execSync('git -C /home/tze/GitHub/butlers rev-parse HEAD').toString().trim();
console.log('direct', JSON.stringify(derivePopulationBlock({ projectShape: apiPoc.projectShape, polarisHtml: direct, butlersRevision })));
console.log('tailnet', JSON.stringify(derivePopulationBlock({ projectShape: apiPoc.projectShape, polarisHtml: tailnet, butlersRevision })));
"
invariantsScript:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Confirms both /polaris forms (direct, tailnet) carry the identical claim-tuple population -- so the population block does not depend on which host form was captured. Reads the two captured HTML files and counts distinct `data-claim-id` attribute values with the same regex the shipped module uses (\sdata-claim-id="([^"]*)") after decoding the five standard HTML entities, then asserts the two sets are equal and that itemCount from projectShape.counts.items matches the module's modelItemCount() on both forms.
import json, re, sys

CLAIM_ID = re.compile(r'\sdata-claim-id="([^"]*)"')


def decode(s):
    return (s.replace('"', '"').replace(''', "'").replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>').replace('&', '&'))


def ids(html):
    return {decode(m.group(1)) for m in CLAIM_ID.finditer(html)}


direct = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
tailnet = open(sys.argv[2]).read()
api_poc = json.load(open(sys.argv[3]))

d_ids, t_ids = ids(direct), ids(tailnet)
assert d_ids == t_ids, f'direct/tailnet claim-id populations differ: {len(d_ids)} vs {len(t_ids)}'

shape = api_poc['projectShape']
model_items = shape['counts']['items'] if shape.get('kind') == 'observed' and shape.get('counts') else 0
print(f'distinct claim ids (both forms): {len(d_ids)}')
print(f'model itemCount: {model_items}')
